_readme: The render-perf gate's single source of truth (ITEM-10 / ITEM-11).
It lives at a PERMANENT product path — never under .lifecycle/ — because the e2e gate reads
it and .lifecycle/ is stripped at merge.
`baseline` is MEASURED, not asserted: every value was captured by the harness against the
unmodified tree at the recorded `gitSha`, on the recorded `machine`. `budgets` is what the
specs gate on. Every `budgets.K` must be numerically STRICTER than `baseline.K` — a budget
looser than its own baseline is a no-op gate, and `renderPerfBudgets.test.ts` (TEST-2) makes
`recordedMs` is DELIBERATELY NOT GATED (DEC-3). The recapture measured a ~3x swing in box
load inside one run set (1-min load average 271 -> 88 on 192 cores) with visibly contaminated
wall time, while the COUNTER metrics reproduced bit-identically (2492 / 2492) and the 200k
control's ScriptDuration landed within 0.4% of the month-old figure. So counters gate; ms is
recorded for the record and normalized only as a same-run control RATIO.

baseline._measuredBy: tests/viz-e2e/render-perf.spec.ts, run against this tree before ITEM-3 landed. Two consecutive drives agreed EXACTLY (2484.8 / 2484.8) — TEST-3.
_overflowNote: 192 = MenuRowButton 96 + the Popover container family 96 (Popover 24, PopoverTrigger 16,
Ellipsis 16, PopoverContent/Root/Popup/Positioner/Portal 8 each), measured per wheel on the
PRE-FIX THE BUDGET'S PREMISE WAS UNREACHABLE. TEST-P4 asks for a width at which NOTHING folds.
No such width existed: the pinned group's wrapper is `flex-1`, so `measure()` learned its GROWN
scrollWidth (2072px on a 2304px toolbar) as the group's 'natural' width, leaving availFull ~202px
against ~204px of foldable icons — so exactly one item (`split`) folded at EVERY width on EVERY
pane, and the overflow Popover was mounted unconditionally. Recorded as the ITEM-3 drift finding;
the fix measures the CONTENT node instead.

recordedMs._note: NEVER a gate (DEC-3). Recorded so a change of kind is visible; the gate is the same-run ratio.

structural._note: INV-10 ratchet — thresholds move DOWN per split, never up. Baselines re-measured on acbe0fca.

machine.viewport: 1280x820 (config default); TEST-P4 overrides to 1900x900 to reach a no-fold width
machine.reactStrictMode: ON for the counter leg (its 2x is why chrome reads 8/wheel at 4 panes), OFF for the ms leg
